title: Change an appointment's status
summary: Confirmed, arrived, in progress, completed, no-show: from the appointment menu.

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: The calendar shows appointments by room and doctor.

steps.title: Right-click the appointment
steps.details: The appointment menu opens. If you don't see it, change the day with the arrows or use Find appointment.

steps.title: Change status
steps.details: Hover over Change status to see the statuses.

steps.title: Choose the new status
steps.details: Confirmed: they said they're coming. Arrived: they're in the waiting room. In progress: they're being seen. Completed: the visit is over. No-show: they didn't come or call. Only the changes allowed from the current status are enabled.
